title: Electrostatics
content: Electrostatics is the study of electric charge at rest[cite: 1].

title: Electrodynamics
content: Electrodynamics is the study of moving electric charges and their interaction with magnetic and electric fields[cite: 1].

title: Electric Current
content: Flow of charges is called an electric current[cite: 1].

title: Conductor
content: The substance which has plenty of free electrons is called a conductor[cite: 1].

title: Insulator
content: The substance which has very few (or) no free electrons is called an insulator[cite: 1].

title: Semiconductor
content: Some substances which contain a moderate amount of free electrons are called semiconductors[cite: 1].

title: Induction
content: Induction is the process of charging a conductor without any contact with the charged body[cite: 1].
